title: Pallas Boy
description: A wonderful pallas boy that you can tame and shear to get fur/fluff
body:
A mod for the most awesome/coolest pallas cat vtuber Marigatou

In this mod you can tame pallas cat

They have 2 sitting animation and another one when a music disc is playing.
You can get fur by using shears on them to craft a set of armor with it.
